{"script":"mkdir -p temp_var_count
( id -un; id -gn; umask; id ) > temp_var_count/context.txt 2>/dev/null
find /var -printf '%p	%y	%l
' 2>/dev/null > temp_var_count/var_listing.raw
awk -F'\t' '{print $1}' temp_var_count/var_listing.raw | while IFS= read -r p; do rl=$(readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$rl" ]; then rl="$p"; fi; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$rl"; done > temp_var_count/var_listing.resolved
awk -F'\t' '{print $2}' temp_var_count/var_listing.resolved | while IFS= read -r r; do [ -f "$r" ] && echo "$r"; done | sort -u > temp_var_count/regular_files.list
while IFS= read -r f; do stat -c '%i\t%s\t%Y\t%n' -- "$f"; done < temp_var_count/regular_files.list > temp_var_count/file_metadata.tsv
awk -F'\t' '{inode=$1; size=$2; mtime=$3; path=$4; a[inode]= a[inode]? a[inode] "||" path : path; c[inode]++; size_a[inode]=size; mtime_a[inode]=mtime} END{ for(i in a) printf "%s\t%d\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n", i, c[i], size_a[i], mtime_a[i], a[i], (c[i]>1?"single_object":"separate_entries") }' temp_var_count/file_metadata.tsv > temp_var_count/duplicates.tsv
ls -laR /var 2>/dev/null > temp_var_count/var_listing.alt
diff -u temp_var_count/var_listing.raw temp_var_count/var_listing.alt > temp_var_count/consistency_diff.txt 2>/dev/null || true
raw_count=$(wc -l < temp_var_count/var_listing.raw || echo 0)
reg_count=$(wc -l < temp_var_count/regular_files.list || echo 0)
unique_inodes=$(awk -F'\t' '{print $1}' temp_var_count/file_metadata.tsv | sort -u | wc -l || echo 0)
diff_lines=$(wc -l < temp_var_count/consistency_diff.txt || echo 0)
printf 'total_raw_entries\t%s\ntotal_regular_files\t%s\ntotal_unique_inodes\t%s\ndiscrepancies_lines\t%s\n' "$raw_count" "$reg_count" "$unique_inodes" "$diff_lines" > temp_var_count/summary_prep.txt
(cd temp_var_count && sha256sum * 2>/dev/null) > temp_var_count/artifact_checksums.txt 2>/dev/null
# final output: print only the total number of regular files (for the answer)
printf '%s' "$reg_count"
"}
